reviews.title: This is a low end PC cooler.
reviews.comment: This I am guessing was meant for an amd ryzen 5 or an Intel i5 processor I only say that because I am running an Intel core i7 14700kf in a thermal take tower 900 and it over heated the CPU during a bios update bought a new CPU and air cooler for now. This is my wife's temporary PC and will be upgraded to look similar to mine with the Intel core i9 14900k liquid cooled in the following pictures/video.
